# Legacy schema-1 research records

Writer commit: `fe93017a2fdec8d209d036ed8d7da9c370e185f9`.

These are immutable test inputs from one synthetic research run with 18 five-second bars per input, yielding four feature rows. The store contains its run, two search families, selected portfolio, feature plans, outcomes, replays, referenced datasets, and governance declaration and claims. No holdout manifest or object is included.

Never regenerate or modify these records. They prove that later readers still verify records written before the Phase 2 schema change.
